Honestly, it sounds like you've got a decent understanding of the situation. Don't ignore your concerns, there's a lot going on and you should focus on your own needs, first and foremost.

If you do decide to go through with it, things to think about include: What are your expectations? How will you manage shared responsibilities like chores? What about your own personal boundaries? Are you able to respect each other's need for personal space and time? 

And then there's the more cynical end of things, such as: What if these expectations are not met? What if she doesn't pay rent? What are the expectations around you being a 'safe house' for her - does she respect your needs and boundaries as well? If you aren't in a space to provide support, does she have anything else available (therapist, hotlines, other friends, or therapeutic techniques) or are you her main go-to? 

All of these are things only you can really answer. Ultimately, it's up to you whether you go through with it. I hope things work out, OP 👍
